name: softmax_sweep
description: Softmax builds one long dependency chain per head.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> REDUCE(max) -> LOAD(subtract) -> EXP2/FMA chain -> REDUCE(sum) -> FMA(div) -> STORE(output)

name: rmsnorm_sweep
description: RMSNorm is modeled as per-row input, reduction, rescale, shared weight load, and output store.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> FMA(square) -> REDUCE(sum) -> FMA(scale) -> LOAD(weight shared) -> FMA(mul) -> STORE(output)

name: silu_sweep
description: SiLU is modeled as a long elementwise chain dominated by EXP2 and FMA latency.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> FMA(negate) -> EXP2 -> FMA(add1) -> FMA(div/mul) -> STORE(output)

name: rope_sweep
description: RoPE mixes shared theta data with per-row input and output streams.
dependency_chain: LOAD(theta shared) -> FMA(angle) -> LOAD(input) -> FMA(real/imag) -> STORE(output)
